senses.gloss: pr. n. m.Shila, name of several Amoraim.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 172a:2">B. Bath. 172ᵃ</cite> <he>רבא בר רב ש׳</he> (<cite ref="T00060"><he>רבה</he></cite>) (ed. Pes. <he>שייא</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 10).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 98b:14">Snh. 98ᵇ</cite> <he>דבי רבי ש׳</he> those of the house (or school) of R. Sh.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 2:5:3">Y. Sabb. II, 5ᵃ</cite> top <he>רבי ש׳ דינוה</he>; <cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 5:9">Ruth R. to II, 19</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="N00316"><he>נָוֶה</he> III</cite>.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 8:1:2">Y. Snh. VIII, beg. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>ר׳ ש׳ בר בינא</he>; Y. Gitt. II, 44ᵇ <he>בינה שילוח</he> (prob. to be read: <he>ש׳ בר בינא</he>).—Y. Macc. II, 31ᵈ bot. <he>ר׳ שִׁילֹה</he>.—V. Fr. M’bo, p. 124ᵇ.—
<cite ref="Gittin 69a:4">Gitt. 69ᵃ</cite> (in a charm formula) <he>אנא פפי ש׳ בר סומקי</he>.—
